articles.headline: Week 9 preview: ATX Bowers need RB help and a defense
articles.dek: Our projection has ATX Bowers at 110.8 points, 11th of 12 teams, so the cheap upgrades matter.

articles.headline: ATX Bowers fall to 1-8 with 33.8 points left on bench
articles.dek: A 84.16-point loss to The Dakstreet Boys came with 33.8 points on the bench, though even a perfect lineup would have fallen short.

articles.headline: ATX Bowers beat Lover Boys 153.56-99.3, but leave 24.7 on bench
articles.dek: Tony Pollard's 28.7 points carried a comfortable win, but a Dalton Kincaid-for-Mason Taylor swap alone cost 13.7.

articles.headline: ATX Bowers Fall to 0-7 Despite Pollard's 36.5-Point Day
articles.dek: Tony Pollard and Drake Maye carried the lineup, but Aaron Jones and a handful of misfires left ATX Bowers 12.5 points short of Bucky Charms.
